Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 We are looking for a Python Developer with 3–4 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable software solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality applications.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using Python.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization activities.
Collaborate with developers, testers, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions.
Support application enhancements, bug fixes, and ongoing maintenance.
 Requirements
 Required technical and professional expertise
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Python development.
Experience with at least one Python framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
Familiarity with Git and Agile development methodologies.
Understanding of object-oriented programming principles and software development best practices.
Experience working with APIs and system integrations.
Good communication skills in English.
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
 French language at least B2 is considered a plus.
